spanish: Y la arnévet, porque subiente cud ella, y pezuña no partió; impura ella a ustedes.

findings.issue: Common noun (not a name) is dumped as the transliteration arnévet instead of Spanish.
Hiphil participle is causative; subiente keeps only simple upward motion and drops that stem force.
Common noun is left as English cud rather than Spanish, and cud pins one sense the bare noun morphology leaves open.
Hiphil perfect 3fs is the animal dividing the hoof; pezuña no partió makes the hoof the subject of an intransitive split.

notes: porque, both ella, impura, and a ustedes match the conjunction, the two 3fs pronouns, the fs adjective, and 2mp לָכֶם.
